gloss: to ride past; to miss one's stop

definitions.gloss: to ride past; to miss one's stop
definitions.explanation: to stay on a train, bus, etc. past the intended destination

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}を{乗|の}り{過|す}ごした。
{居眠|いねむ}りして{終点|しゅうてん}まで{乗|の}り{過|す}ごしてしまった。
examples.english: I dozed off and rode all the way to the terminal.

examples.japanese: スマホに{夢中|むちゅう}で{乗|の}り{過|す}ごさないように。
examples.english: Don't miss your stop because you're absorbed in your phone.

notes:
{乗|の}り{過|す}ごす is commonly used for missing stops on public transportation.

VERB TYPE:
- Godan verb (す-verb)
- Transitive (takes を)

COMPOUND STRUCTURE:
- {乗|の}る (to ride) + {過|す}ごす (to spend/pass)
- Part of the productive ～{過|す}ごす compound pattern

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {駅|えき}を{乗|の}り{過|す}ごす (miss a station)
- バス{停|てい}を{乗|の}り{過|す}ごす (miss a bus stop)
- {終点|しゅうてん}まで{乗|の}り{過|す}ごす (ride to the terminal)
- うっかり{乗|の}り{過|す}ごす (accidentally ride past)

COMMON CAUSES:
- {居眠|いねむ}り (dozing)
- スマホ (smartphone)
- {本|ほん} (reading a book)
- {考|かんが}え{事|ごと} (lost in thought)

RELATED COMPOUND VERBS:
- {通|とお}り{過|す}ぎる (to pass by)
- {見過|みすご}ごす (to overlook)
- {聞|き}き{過|す}ごす (to fail to hear)

SIMILAR EXPRESSIONS:
- {乗|の}り{過|す}ぎる (to ride too much/long - different meaning)

CULTURAL NOTE:
- Very common experience in Japan given extensive train/subway use
- Station announcements help prevent this
- Apps like {乗換案内|のりかえあんない} have alarm features

REGISTER: Neutral. Very common in everyday conversation.
